asset.name: AppShell
asset.description: The one application frame a generated scenario mounts: brand, a SidebarShell-owned navigation column (resizable sidebar or icon rail), a BottomNav-owned phone tab bar or drawer, an optional header strip, a skip link, and the routed main pane in scroll or fill mode. Navigation is data; the router plugs in through renderLink and onNavigate.

requires.reason: Sizing, spacing, radius, and layer order resolve to declared ramps.
Consumer className merges through the shared helper.
The desktop navigation column, drawer, and resize seam are owned by SidebarShell rather than re-drawn here.
The phone tab bar is owned by BottomNav; the same item list drives both presentations.
The drawer's menu control is the governed icon button, so its tap target and focus ring are not re-implemented.
The md breakpoint is the library's, read once, so the shell and its navigation assets agree on where a phone ends.
User-facing copy resolves through the adopting host locale bridge.

regions.purpose: Primary application navigation in whichever presentation the viewport calls for.
Global toolbar for search, global actions, status, and account controls.
The routed page content mounted beneath the shell.
Optional persistent workspace panel beside the main content.
